entities.summary: Trayce Jackson-Davis, more commonly referred to by his initials "TJD", is an American professional basketball player for the Toronto Raptors of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Indiana Hoosiers. He was selected 57th overall in the 2023 NBA draft by the Golden State Warriors. Jackson-Davis played nearly 3 full seasons with the Warriors before he was traded to the Raptors in February of 2026.
